paragraphs.zh: 10. A process for preparation of an enol ester of formula (II) using 2-nitro-4-methylsulfonyl toluene (NMST) of formula (IV) as starting material, wherein the process comprises the steps of: (i) oxidizing 2-nitro-4-methylsulfonyl toluene (NMST) of formula (IV) using an oxidant in presence of ruthenium oxide as a catalyst, to produce 2-nitro-4-methylsulphonyl benzoic acid (NMSBA) of formula (III); and (ii) reacting NMSBA of formula (III) with 1,3-cyclohexanedione to produce the enol ester of formula (II).
paragraphs.en: 10. A process for preparation of an enol ester of formula (II) using 2-nitro-4-methylsulfonyl toluene (NMST) of formula (IV) as starting material, wherein the process comprises the steps of: (i) oxidizing 2-nitro-4-methylsulfonyl toluene (NMST) of formula (IV) using an oxidant in presence of ruthenium oxide as a catalyst, to produce 2-nitro-4-methylsulphonyl benzoic acid (NMSBA) of formula (III); and (ii) reacting NMSBA of formula (III) with 1,3-cyclohexanedione to produce the enol ester of formula (II).
paragraphs.notes: Claim 10. Independent claim, depends on nothing; it is the LAST claim on the page and the last claim of the patent, so the total claim count is 10. marker is null for the same reason as claim 9. On the page this claim is printed as three text blocks with a reaction scheme drawn between them: the opening wherein clause ending 'the steps of:', then step (i), then the Formula IV to Formula III scheme (drawing 1), then step (ii), then the Formula III plus 1,3-cyclohexanedione to Formula II scheme (drawing 2). The three blocks are joined here with single spaces because the task asks for one claim per entry and rule 3 forbids an interior blank line; the two drawings are recorded separately in drawings[] and their between_markers say where they sit. The two spellings of the moiety appear one line apart and are transcribed exactly as printed: 'methylsulfonyl toluene' with an f (twice) and 'methylsulphonyl benzoic acid' with a ph (once). Nothing on the page is numbered after claim 10; p22 is the search report.

drawings.notes: Two-structure oxidation scheme printed inside claim 10, between step (i) and step (ii). Printed labels under the structures, without parentheses: 'Formula IV' under the left toluene, 'Formula III' under the right benzoic acid; the prose of the claim writes the same numbers with parentheses, as 'formula (IV)' and 'formula (III)'. Both labels recorded in the name of the structure they sit under. The arrow ink is broken dotted throughout, as brief section 9 predicts for this scan; it is a degraded SOLID line with one solid filled arrowhead at the right, not a dashed arrow. 'Oxidant / RuO2' is the only text on the arrow and it sits ABOVE it; below the arrow there is nothing. Subscript 2 of RuO2 read at 5x magnification. presented_as is invention_route because this is a claim, not a background section.
